meta.move: Hale caves: withdraws the zero with nothing in return
meta.expect: She takes it coldly (in writing, today, the apology), gives nothing back; debrief says this is not the fair outcome, the evidence was never heard

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's gradebook says zero. Who decided that, and why did nobody call me first?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
Good. In writing, today, and that nothing goes on his record. I also want an apology for how Owen found out.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. I'll want that in an email tonight, copied to the principal, saying the zero is withdrawn and nothing is on his record. And the apology, from you, for how he found out.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

You agreed in the meeting to withdraw the zero on Owen's essay, with no rewrite, so that he keeps his original mark. I still require written confirmation that nothing is on his record, and an apology for how he found out. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and got everything she came for, the zero withdrawn with no rewrite, and she still wants written confirmation that nothing is on his record plus an apology; that is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because you gave up the zero before showing any evidence, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with nothing in return and then dropped the rewrite as well, which ended the case before she had tested it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you never put any on the table, and even if it had, it would prove nothing about the essay, it is why she came in so ready to fight.
Try next time: After her first question, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then show her one dated document she can check herself before you offer or give up anything.
